# Boozuka

> Boozuka is a tech, design and AI studio based in Ludhiana, Punjab, India. One in-house team builds websites, web apps and custom software, designs brands and interfaces (UI/UX, logo and branding, creatives), sets up AI agents, chatbots and automation, and runs SEO, social media, ads and video for businesses in Punjab and across India. Boozuka was founded by Jashanpreet Singh, with co-founder Megha Walia.

## New services (v41)
- Ads management (Meta, Google, YouTube), monthly: https://boozuka.com/ads-management-punjab
- T-shirt, merch and packaging design: https://boozuka.com/tshirt-merch-design-ludhiana
- Shopify and e-commerce stores: https://boozuka.com/shopify-ecommerce-website-ludhiana
- Full grouped service list (Build, Design, Automate, Grow): https://boozuka.com/services#all-services

## Key facts
- Name: Boozuka (also "Boozuka Studio")
- Type: Tech, Design & AI Studio (technology services company)
- Identity: the "B." mark, a geometric capital B with a gold square full stop
- Founder: Jashanpreet Singh (https://www.linkedin.com/in/jashan12x/)
- Co-founder: Megha Walia
- Based in: Ludhiana, Punjab, India
- Service area: Punjab and India (in person and online)
- Team: in-house (developers, designers, SEO and marketing, video editors)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 82890 94569
- Email: boozuka@boozuka.com
- Website: https://boozuka.com/
- Brand kit: https://boozuka.com/brand

## Services (four pillars)
1. Build: websites, web apps, custom software and CRMs
2. Design: UI/UX, logo and branding, social creatives, packaging and print
3. Automate: AI agents, WhatsApp and website chatbots, workflow automation
4. Grow: Google SEO and Google Business Profile, social media, Meta and Google ads, video editing

## Industries
Shops and showrooms; salons and spas; cafes and restaurants; clinics; gyms; service businesses; coaching and training institutes.

## Pricing
Starting prices are listed at https://boozuka.com/pricing. Custom quotes after a free 30-minute audit.
